plan.notes: Source: official transfer degree map 'HCC Associate of Arts: Business Field of Study to University of Houston-Downtown Bachelor of Business Administration in Management' — '4-Year Suggested Academic Plan for Transfer, Effective 2025-2026 Catalog Year', Revised 09/24/2025, hosted on uhd.edu. Only the HCC associate-degree portion (First Year + Second Year, 60 SCH) is captured here; the UHD junior/senior years are not part of this plan. HCC Field of Study: Designated Core Courses ECON 2301, MATH 1324; Discipline Foundation Courses ECON 2302, ACCT 2301, ACCT 2302, BUSI 1301 — FOS courses are guaranteed to transfer to all Texas public institutions. (1) EDUC 1300 is required for First Time in College (FTIC) students only; if not FTIC, student takes SPCH 1321 Business and Professional Communication. The guide prints standard Texas common course numbers but does not label them TCCNS, so transfer_confidence is left blank. No per-course prerequisites are stated in the guide.
